<h1>Chase Wiedemann</h1>

<p class="intro-copy">I am a PhD candidate in economics at Olin Business School, Washington University in St. Louis. My research focuses on local public finance, urban economics, and political economy.</p>
<p>I study how the organization of local governments affects public goods and the growth of U.S. metropolitan areas. In particular, I am interested in the tradeoffs between coordination across jurisdictions and competition among them.</p>
<p>My current work examines local government centralization and metropolitan growth.</p>
<p>Feel free to reach out at <a href="mailto:c.j.wiedemann@wustl.edu">c.j.wiedemann@wustl.edu</a>.</p>
